componentConsumption.label: 2. component consumption (import analysis)

p31ca_public.note: consumes via copied CSS (p31-core.css etc.), not via the package

ws_planetary_planet.note: Astro marketing site; no design-core dependency

componentConsumption.method: grep -r "from '@p31ca/design-core" across the three consumer surfaces (read-only); unique component names extracted from compositions import braces.

tokenCompliance.label: 3. token compliance (raw hex/rgba/px that should be tokens)

value.headline: design portal is COLOR-CLEAN (0 hex/rgb) but has 61 px-on-scalable hits; p31ca-public is the main raw-color surface (2045 hex hits); planetary-planet nearly clean (19 hex hits)

tokenCompliance.method: node compliance-scan.mjs — walker over read-only consumer dirs; flags #hex/#rgba/px-on-scalable in .css/.tsx/.html/.astro/.mdx; negative control fixture flags all three classes.

patternAdherence.label: 4. pattern adherence (data-theme / data-spoons attributes)

value.note: grep counts files containing data-theme or data-spoons (theme/spoon-awareness pattern); planetary-planet does not participate (no canon dependency).

patternAdherence.method: grep -rl "data-theme\|data-spoons" per surface (read-only). Attribute occurrences, not full theme-mix correctness.
